newsitem.title: DENMARK: Novo anti-depressant pill sales up.
newsitem.headline: Novo anti-depressant pill sales up.

text.p: Sales of Danish drugmaker Novo Nordisk's Seroxat and Paxil anti-depressant pills are growing fast but still have a long way to go to catch up with rival Eli Lilly's market-leading Prozac brand.

Figures published on Tuesday by British-American medical group SmithKline Beecham, which markets Novo's Seroxat and Paxil products outside the Nordic region, showed a 42 percent increase in turnover of the drugs in 1996 to 706 million stg.
Global Prozac sales, although logging a lower 14 percent growth rate last year totalled $2.356 billion, a recent Lilly report said.
Novo's anti-depressant sales were less than half those of Prozac, for which Lilly reported a rise in domestic U.S. demand, while overseas sales were unchanged.
SmithKline's Seroxat and Paxil sales data does not include Novo sales of the drugs in the Nordic region. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969653
